name: Envira Gallery
couldBuild: Galleries with a lightbox, responsive images, albums and lazy loading. This is one of the most solved problems in WordPress.
stillMissing: Not much technically — the paid value is breadth of add-ons (watermarking, proofing, EXIF, social sharing, WooCommerce selling) rather than anything hard. If you need two of those, build it. If you need six, buy it.
requirements: Gallery and album management with drag-and-drop ordering
A lightbox with keyboard, touch and deep-link support
Responsive images and lazy loading that respect srcset
Pagination or infinite scroll for large galleries

alternatives.name: Envira Gallery Lite
alternatives.desc: Core galleries and lightbox; add-ons are the paid tier.

alternatives.name: Core Gallery block
alternatives.desc: Core galleries plus a lightbox now cover simple cases.
